seoTitle: This Is Us Test: Which Character Are You? (11 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the This Is Us test: 11 everyday questions reveal whether you're Jack, Rebecca, Kevin, Kate, Randall, Beth, Toby or William — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the hero dad, the golden boy, or the voice of reason? Answer 11 everyday questions about family, pressure and the people you love, and find out which This Is Us character you are.

characters.name: Jack Pearson
characters.title: The Hero Dad
characters.summary: Protective, hardworking and a big romantic at heart. You'd do anything for your family, and you rarely ask for help.
description: Like Jack, you work hard for the people you love. He served in Vietnam, worked in construction and dreamed of starting his own company, Big Three Homes.
You keep your struggles to yourself. Jack fought a drinking problem for years before he finally went to AA.
You'd run into a fire for your family, literally. Jack got his kids out of the burning house, then died in hospital from the effects of the smoke.
characters.flaw: You carry everything on your own shoulders so nobody else has to see you struggle.
characters.signature: A flannel shirt, a toolbox and a romantic gesture up your sleeve.
characters.clashReason: they'd insist on fixing it all themselves and never let you help

characters.name: Rebecca Pearson
characters.title: The Heart of the Family
characters.summary: Loving, strong-willed and always thinking of everyone else. You hold the whole family together.
description: Like Rebecca, you'd put your family before almost anything. She gave up her dream of being a singer to raise the Big Three.
You keep going when life falls apart. After Jack died, Rebecca held the family together, and years later she married his best friend, Miguel.
You love fiercely, and it shows. Even as dementia takes hold later in her life, Rebecca's family stays at the centre of everything.
characters.flaw: You worry about everyone else so much that you forget to look after yourself.
characters.signature: A full table, an old song you still know every word of and a hug for whoever needs it.
characters.clashReason: they'd worry about you more than you worry about yourself

characters.name: Kevin Pearson
characters.title: The Golden Boy
characters.summary: Charming, funny and made for the spotlight. Underneath it all, you just want to know you're good enough.
description: Like Kevin, you know how to work a room. He found fame as the star of a sitcom called The Manny, then went on to Broadway and films.
You worry what people think more than you'd admit. Kevin often felt overlooked next to his brother, Randall.
You can turn things around. After a knee injury led to addiction, Kevin got sober, became a dad to twins and, in the end, found his way back to Sophie.
characters.flaw: You need people's approval so much that it drives your choices.
characters.signature: A camera-ready smile, a big entrance and a big apology after.
characters.clashReason: they'd make it all about them, then apologise beautifully

characters.name: Kate Pearson
characters.title: The Big Heart
characters.summary: Funny, loyal and full of feeling. You doubt yourself far more than anyone else ever doubts you.
description: Like Kate, you're your own harshest critic. She struggles with her weight and self-esteem for much of the show.
You've got a voice worth hearing. Kate gets back to singing, and she ends up teaching at a music school for blind students.
You're fiercely loyal. Kate is Kevin's twin and his biggest defender, and she met Toby at a weight-loss support group.
characters.flaw: You talk yourself out of good things before you've even tried them.
characters.signature: A playlist for every mood, a twin on speed dial and a heart on your sleeve.
characters.clashReason: they'd doubt themselves until you wanted to shake them

characters.name: Randall Pearson
characters.title: The Overachiever
characters.summary: Driven, caring and always prepared. You plan for everything, and you want everyone to be okay.
description: Like Randall, you hold yourself to very high standards. He was adopted by the Pearsons as a baby, and he grew up trying to be perfect.
You want answers. Randall tracked down his biological father, William, and brought him into his family's life.
You carry a lot. Randall goes from finance to city council, while trying to be everything to everyone at home.
characters.flaw: You try to control things that were never yours to control.
characters.signature: A colour-coded plan, a dad joke and a backup plan for the backup plan.
characters.clashReason: they'd take over your problem and make a plan for it

characters.name: Beth Pearson
characters.title: The Voice of Reason
characters.summary: Calm, funny and completely honest. You keep everyone grounded, and you don't put up with nonsense.
description: Like Beth, you stay graceful under pressure. She's the steady one in Randall's life, whatever chaos is going on.
You tell people what they need to hear. Beth's dry, honest humour keeps Randall and the whole family in check.
You make room for your own dreams too. Beth trained as a dancer, and she ends up running her own dance studio.
characters.flaw: You're so good at holding everyone up that people forget you need holding up too.
characters.signature: Perfect posture, a raised eyebrow and the last word.
characters.clashReason: they'd see right through you and say so

characters.name: Toby Damon
characters.title: The Class Clown
characters.summary: Loud, goofy and all-in on the people you love. You make everyone laugh, even when you're struggling.
description: Like Toby, you're never short of a joke. He walks into Kate's weight-loss support group and charms her with jokes from day one.
You hide hard things behind a smile. Toby lives with serious depression, and he doesn't always let people see it.
You go all in. Toby throws himself into his relationship with Kate, though in the end they divorce.
characters.flaw: You joke so much that people miss it when you're really not okay.
characters.signature: A terrible pun, a loud laugh and a lot of enthusiasm.
characters.clashReason: they'd crack a joke right when you wanted them to be serious

characters.name: William Hill
characters.title: The Gentle Soul
characters.summary: Gentle, wise and grateful for the little things. You've made mistakes, and they've made you kinder.
description: Like William, you notice beauty in small moments. He's a gifted musician who played and sang in a band in Memphis.
You've got regrets, and you've learned from them. William struggled with addiction, and he left baby Randall at a fire station.
You make the most of the time you have. William reconnects with Randall as an adult, and he dies during their road trip together to Memphis.
characters.flaw: You carry old regrets so long that you forget you're allowed to put them down.
characters.signature: A piano, a quiet porch and an eye for the little things.
characters.clashReason: they'd make you slow down when you were in a hurry

questions.text: A close friend's birthday is coming up. You...

options.text: Plan a surprise so big they'll still be talking about it in ten years
Make a spreadsheet: guest list, timings and a backup venue
Turn up with a cake, a terrible song and a lot of enthusiasm
Send a funny message on the day. They know you love them
A big lunch with everyone round the table
A movie marathon on the sofa, doing all the voices
Sitting on the porch with a coffee, watching the world go by
A dance class, then a long brunch

questions.text: Someone criticises your work in front of other people. You...

options.text: Smile through it, then replay it in your head all night
Work twice as hard until they have to take it back
Laugh it off, then go and find someone who'll tell you you're great
Make one dry comment that gets a bigger laugh than their criticism

questions.text: You're going through a hard time, and a friend asks how you are. You...

options.text: Tell them you're fine. You're the one who looks after everyone else
Crack a joke so nobody worries
Tell them everything, and have a bit of a cry
Turn it round and ask how they're doing

questions.text: You're asked to give a speech at a friend's wedding. You...

options.text: Write something quiet and heartfelt that makes the whole room cry
Wing it. You're great in front of a crowd
Fill it with jokes, including at least one that goes too far
Politely say no. Someone else would do it better

questions.text: Someone close to you keeps making the same bad decision. You...

options.text: Step in and try to fix it for them
Tell them the truth, kindly but firmly
Stay close and be patient. They have to get there themselves
Back them, whatever they decide. You'd hate to fall out

questions.text: Money is tight this month. You...

options.text: Pick up extra shifts. Your family won't go without
Lie awake doing the maths, again and again
Cook something cheap and make it feel like a feast
Don't panic. You don't need much to be happy

questions.text: A friend says you should take up something you loved but gave up years ago. You...

options.text: Go for it. It's never too late
Go for it, but only if a friend comes with you
Sign up that same night. Why not?
Say no. Too many people are relying on you right now

questions.text: Your family is together for the holidays, and an argument breaks out. You...

options.text: Step in and calm everyone down. Not today
Come up with a plan that everyone can agree on
Say what everyone's thinking, and end it
Head outside and wait for it to blow over

questions.text: You find out that your parent kept a big secret from you for years, to protect you. You...

options.text: Confront them straight away. You deserved to know
Try to understand why they did it before you react
Forgive them. People do strange things out of love
Act like it doesn't bother you, then let it bother you for months

questions.text: You get to go back and relive one day of your life. You pick...

options.text: The day you met the love of your life
An ordinary day with everyone together, nothing special
A day you'd do differently this time
The day you were the star of the show
